summary: This bill requires the Department of Homeland Security to decentralize its Office of Intelligence and Analysis by moving primary analytic functions from headquarters to field offices and assigning intelligence officers and analysts to every fusion center and joint task force to improve interagency collaboration and intelligence sharing.
